decisions.decision: Chat context must be preserved before old chats are deleted

principles.interpretation: Old chats do not get cleared until working context is locked into durable artifacts. Now codified as system behavior.
If GitHub push is blocked, preserve in Notion immediately. Never let context evaporate waiting for ideal conditions.

principles.interpretation: Session context should live in durable pages, not evaporate with chat threads.

historical_significance: GENESIS SESSION for the preservation-first doctrine. This is where Michael first ordered context preservation before chat deletion, establishing the foundational principle that became the entire reincarnation system. The REINCARNATE command was invoked. The canonical repo was named. The local fallback pattern (Notion staging when GitHub blocked) was established. Every pulse run's Platform Death Test traces back to this moment — the fear of lost context driving permanent artifact creation.
